name: @kanzo-tech/ai
description: Kanzo AI surfaces — a field the model helps fill (Assist) and a conversation with one (Chat), over the AI SDK through @kanzo-tech/llm. Sibling of @kanzo-tech/ui, not part of it.
//peers: @kanzo-tech/ui and Ark are required peers rather than dependencies — two copies of Ark would mean two portals and two focus traps. `ai` and `@ai-sdk/react` are REQUIRED peers for the reason @kanzo-tech/llm gives: the host's agent and these components must share one UIMessage, one transport and one useChat. streamdown is a dependency now: Chat renders markdown, and a conversation that draws plain text is not one this package offers. `@kanzo-tech/mosaic` is OPTIONAL: only `./data` imports it, beside `@kanzo-tech/ui`'s `/analytics` and `/table`, whose own optional peers a host of `./data` installs too.
//size-limit: The root barrel, measured without the peers and dependencies a host already has. Assist and Chat tree-shake apart: a host that only assists fields does not ship the transcript, and the markdown parser comes with Chat alone. `./data` is measured on its own, without the analytics and table engines it draws with. Raised 6 kB -> 6.5 kB on 2026-10-03 as a decision (branch `fix/ask-statement-gate`): 5.12 kB before, 6.18 kB after `gateStatement` — the one door from a model's SQL to the page's engine, which reads DuckDB's parse and words each refusal for the model — and `QueryResult` drawing from its rows. A security fix, not drift; budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it. Measured 6.22 kB on 2026-10-09 (branch `feat/ask-typed-spec`) once the SQL tool, the gate and `QueryResult` gave way to `answerSchema`, `checkAnswer` and `AnswerCard`: not raised. Raised 6.5 kB -> 6.75 kB on 2026-10-09, Ángel's decision (branch `feat/answer-and-dock-feedback`): 6.22 kB -> 6.68 kB, for what grew — `AnswerCard` reading *On the dashboard* from the host's `dashboards`, waiting on its write and drawing a refused one as a `Problem`, and staying busy until its tile is drawn; `readAnswerRelations`' signal and its own `SUMMARIZE`; and `answerRelationsOf`, which replaces what every host wrote by hand. Budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it. Raised 6.75 kB -> 7.25 kB on 2026-10-10 as a decision for review (branch `fix/ai-data-abort-and-skipped`, ui#55 and ui#47): 6.68 kB -> 7.08 kB, for `dataAgent` reading through `Engine.query` with the chat's signal (its rows read from the columns), and the page's clauses a relation cannot answer named for the model and drawn under the card. Budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it. Raised 7.25 kB -> 8.5 kB on 2026-10-10 as a decision for review (branch `fix/ask-context-budget`, `/docs/design/ai-context`, approved by Ángel): 7.15 kB -> 8.39 kB, for describing each type once and each relation by its key (`describeData`), the `context` budget — the estimate, the narrowing by values and then by the question, and `ai/context` — and the relation written as its key. What it buys: LDBC SNB's starters from 10,466 to 1,290 tokens, its first question on Qwen3 from 16,565 to 3,212. Budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it. Raised `./data` 8.75 kB -> 9 kB on 2026-10-11 as a decision put to the owner (branch of the answer card's verbs, `/docs/design/ai`): 8.58 kB -> 8.94 kB once an answer's verbs became icon buttons with tooltips in the tile's header, Filter is disabled with its reason when it would keep everything in view, its chip names what it filters, and the add gives way to *Open on the dashboard*. Budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it. Raised 9 -> 10.2 kB on 2026-10-12, approved by the owner: 10.14 kB once the data subpath carries Kanzo Tasks' Ask (`ask.ts`, ~0.35 kB) and the Task loop it runs on (~0.8 kB). It comes back down when `dataAgent` (`agent.ts`) goes, which Ask as a Task replaces. Lowered 10.2 kB -> 9 kB on 2026-10-12 (branch `claude/lucid-curie-mdloyh`): 8.85 kB once `dataAgent`, `describeData` and `dataSuggestions` went for `useAskChat` and `askOffers`. Raised `./task` 850 B -> 1 kB the same day, by the owner's standing rule to raise a budget when the work needs it: 799 B -> 979 B for `propose`, the offers a list shows before anything is asked. Raised `./data` 9 kB -> 9.5 kB the same day, by that rule: 8.84 kB -> 9.46 kB for `AskChips` and `askAlternatives`, an answer's chips and their checked alternatives. Raised `./task` 1 kB -> 1.2 kB and `./data` 9.5 kB -> 9.75 kB the same day, by that rule: 999 B -> 1.1 kB and 9.46 kB -> 9.57 kB for `verify` and a Task held to a grammar, whose artefact is text in a language.
